newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady, USDA said. Long grain milled rice prices were selling mostly at 20.50-21.00 per cwt.; Medium grain traded mostly at 18.50-19.00; Second heads were mostly steady and Brewers were mostly steady. Rice by-products were uneven with tight supplies and light demand.

In California, rice prices were steady with medium grain selling mostly from 18.00-19.00, second heads were steady, bran was 5.00 lower. California rice ship loadings: For the week ending June 21, 1997, at the Port of Sacramento there were no rice ship loadings.

Inspections of California rice for export: For the week ending June 21, 1997, there were no rice inspections. The yearly total since October 1, 1996 is 9,476,475 cwt compared to 6,992,387 cwt a year ago.
Feed by-products prices (dollars per short ton, FOB mills).
